module_verified.notes: These are initial evidence guidelines, not automatic promotion thresholds. Quality, novelty and overlap must be reviewed.

evidence_notes: A module marked COMPLETED is not necessarily VERIFIED.
H0 means no Tutor-provided hints; prior topic exposure is tracked separately.
No Skill Profile evidence means UNKNOWN, not weak and not mastered.
Do not auto-graduate based on a raw number of solved problems.
Grandfather prior Attempts as historical evidence without rewriting their provenance.
